servinfo.title: Timing Chain and Chain Tensioner Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Timing Chain and Chain Tensioner Components:K14D

attention4.ptxt: After the timing chain has been removed, independently turning the camshaft or crankshaft beyond the allowable angle ranges shown in figure will cause interference between pistons and valves or between the valves themselves, which will cause damage to these parts.
Avoid turning each of the camshaft or crankshaft alone beyond the angle ranges shown in figure.

entry.ptxt: Matchmark on intake VVT actuator (sprocket part) and exhaust VVT actuator

attention3.ptxt: If it is necessary to rotate the camshaft with the timing chain removed, rotate the camshaft after turning crankshaft counterclockwise 30 – 90° as shown in figure.

s1.ptxt: Remove timing chain cover.
Remove timing chain guide No.2 (1).
By turning crankshaft, align camshafts and crankshaft at specific position as follows.

s2.ptxt: Align timing marks (1) on intake VVT actuator (sprocket part) and exhaust VVT actuator with top surface of cylinder head (2).
Check crankshaft sprocket key (3) is aligned with matchmark (4) on cylinder block.

s1.ptxt: Remove timing chain tensioner adjuster (5).
Remove timing chain tensioner (6).
Remove timing chain guide No.1 (7).
Remove timing chain (8), crankshaft timing sprocket (9) and crankshaft sprocket key.

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Timing Chain and Chain Tensioner Inspection:K14D

s1.ptxt: Set crankshaft timing sprocket key (1) and turn crankshaft to bring the key position within a 30° – 90° range (2) counterclockwise from matchmark (3) on cylinder block.

attention3.ptxt: Fit the key in the keyway properly so that it does not tilt.

s1.ptxt: Align timing marks (4) on intake VVT actuator (sprocket part) and exhaust VVT actuator with top surface of cylinder head (5).
Set timing chain while aligning two colored marks (1) of timing chain with groove (2) of intake VVT actuator (sprocket part) and timing marks (3) on exhaust VVT actuator.
Set crankshaft sprocket key and align it with matchmark on cylinder block by turning crankshaft.
Install crankshaft timing sprocket.
Install timing chain while aligning colored mark (4) of timing chain with groove (5) of crankshaft timing sprocket.
Apply engine oil to sliding surface of timing chain guide No.1 (1) and timing chain tensioner (2).
Tighten timing chain guide No.1 bolts (3) to specified torque.
Install timing chain tensioner.
Check that all colored marks (1) of timing chain are aligned with groove (2) of intake VVT actuator (sprocket part) and timing marks (3) on exhaust VVT actuator, and groove (4) of timing sprocket.
Install timing chain tensioner adjuster (1) as follows.

s2.ptxt: While pinching clip (2), push in plunger (3) fully.
Insert a retainer (1.2 – 1.5 mm (0.047 – 0.059 in.) diameter wire or the like) (4) to hole (5) and hold plunger in place.
Install timing chain tensioner adjuster (1) with the retainer (2) inserted.
Tighten timing chain tensioner adjuster bolts (3) to specified torque, and then remove the retainer.

s1.ptxt: Apply engine oil to timing chain, and then turn crankshaft clockwise 720°, and check that the following conditions are satisfied:

item.ptxt: Timing marks (1) of intake VVT actuator (sprocket part) and exhaust VVT actuator are aligned with top surface of cylinder head (2).
Crankshaft sprocket key (3) is aligned with matchmark (4) on cylinder block.

s1.ptxt: Install timing chain guide No.2 (1) and tighten timing chain No.2 guide bolts (2) to specified torque.
Install timing chain cover and crankshaft pulley.
